method: Assigned authors read introductions, formulas, examples, all questions, hints, working and supplements. Chapter copies were read or checked against their read originals. Different authors reviewed changed text with surrounding context. Astra independently reviewed the complete mathematical diff, eight correspondence lessons and 53 persistent contexts; this does not mean all unchanged exercises were independently reread.
